tom: Heads-up: planning tenantized IAM cutover during release window 2024-07-12 01:00 UTC. This will introduce an alternate role name to avoid consumer churn. Need deploybot waves + provider pin and a clear rollback.

li: +1. Plan: add role_alt, update noncritical tenants -> verify -> switch primary. We'll pin provider to ~>4.76 in release branch.

kevin: Suggest waves: wave1 noncritical, wave2 low-traffic, wave3 high-traffic. deploybot holds backend lock per wave. I'll own wave2.

tom: Ops snippets:
```
# pin
deploybot pin-release --branch release/iam-tenant-cutover-2024-07-12
# wave example
deploybot apply --target=module.iam_role["noncritical"] --wave=1 --wait 900
```

li: Rollback path: revert consumers -> deploybot revert-wave --wave=N -> set var.role_primary_name back -> targeted terraform apply to module.iam_role. If state mismatch, import old role: `terraform import module.iam_role.aws_iam_role.resource_manager arn:aws:iam::123:role/old-role`.

kevin: Monitoring: STS AssumeRole error ratio alert > 0.4% -> pause. Also app 403 spike -> page oncall.

deploybot: :robot_face: Pin created by tom. Run is staged: pin -> wave1 -> gate -> wave2 -> gate -> wave3. Use `deploybot abort` to stop. Manual start required after security thumbs-up.

tom: Emergency contacts: @li, @kevin, @tom. Do not proceed past gate if alerts fire. I'll post final runbook here 30m before start. :thumbsup:
